spec2def(oledlg.dll oledlg.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

 # CORE-5743: No ARRAY_SIZE macro

# oledlg.dll is all Rust (oledlg-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/oledlg-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# insobjdlg.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/oledlg-rust/src/oledlg/insobjdlg.rs)
# oledlg_main.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/oledlg-rust/src/oledlg/oledlg_main.rs)
# pastespl.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/oledlg-rust/src/oledlg/pastespl.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
add_library(oledlg_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.c rust_varargs_shim.c)
target_link_libraries(oledlg_shims PRIVATE wine oldnames libole32 libcomdlg32 libuser32 libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(oledlg_shims)
add_cargo_module(oledlg oledlg-cargo oledlg.dll
    KIND win32dll
    BODY_CRATE oledlg-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS oledlg_shims psdk)
